name: Chicago jack
notes: Raw jacking house: an 808 kick and cowbell, swung 909 hats, a JV bass and a rave stab.
code:
setcpm(122/4)

drums: s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.1).duckorbit(2).duckattack(0.1).duckdepth(0.5)
claps: s("~ cp ~ [cp cp]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.5)
hats: s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR909").gain("[0.25 0.12 0.35 0.12]*4").swingBy(1/24, 4)
cowbell: s("~ ~ ~ cb ~ ~ cb ~ ~ cb ~ ~ ~ ~ cb ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.3)
bass: n("<[0 ~ 0 3] [0 ~ 5 3] [0 ~ 0 3] [7 5 3 ~]>").s("jvbass").gain(0.55).lpf(1200).orbit(2)
stab: s("~ stab:4 ~ ~").gain(0.5).room(0.4).delay(0.3).delaytime(0.37).orbit(2)
